title: P48: empty sendingUri rejected
description: protocol-06 §5.4 SubmitMessageRequest.sendingUri is 'a valid URI of the sender'. Readings: (a) accept empty and let the hub participant check reject it; (b) reject at decode/encode. Chosen: (b): empty is not a valid RFC 3986 URI, and the P12 'empty = absent' convention (mimid-1wgh.5.27) does not apply to a required field.
